name: Glow
description: A soft coloured halo that hugs the surface's edge, brightest against the window and fading out over the glow size. It follows the frame's corners, rounded or squared, and dims when the surface loses focus.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Glow strength
parameters.description: Intensity of the halo at the window edge

parameters.name: Glow size
parameters.description: How far the halo reaches from the edge (px)

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Corner rounding the halo follows (px). Match the Border pack's corner radius, not its outer edge, which sits a band width further out

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two, for a pane that sits against a panel or the screen edge. The whole chain follows one answer, taken from the first pack that carries the setting, so the bottom corners are all rounded or all square.

parameters.name: Tint with theme background
parameters.description: Tint the halo with the system background colour (keeping its alpha) so it tracks the theme instead of a fixed colour.
